newsitem.title: UK: London Elec extends gains after profits fall.
newsitem.headline: London Elec extends gains after profits fall.

text.p: Shares in regional power company London Electricity Plc extended early morning gains on Thursday amid renewed bullish sentiment helped by favourable results.
The shares were up 16-1/2p at 656-1/2p by 1211 GMT following an expected fall in first-half profits coupled with a dividend hike. Others in the sector also firmed.
One analyst said the divided of 14.3p, up from 11.5p previously, was better than expected and had boosted the shares.
But others attributed some of the share price reaction to a stock shortage in the market.
"The sector has been bombed out lately and all three independents are having a good morning," one analyst said, adding that sentiment had recovered.
Shares in Southern Electricity were up 14-1/2p at 744p by 1219 GMT and Yorkshire Electricity firmed to be up 3-1/2p at 742-1/2p.
